answers: Amenities, policies, procedures and contacts, from capability triples, then documents
Compliance records (overdue, due, last done); the state of assets without sensors; schedules and closures; whether a space is ready for a booked use
Bookings, work orders and entrance counts, from interval records
What can be measured in a place, and whether its sensor is linked and reporting
Choosing or ranking spaces under several constraints, with assumptions and coverage stated
Why a past condition occurred: candidate explanations ranked from readings, anomaly episodes and reports
Plans and locations; areas, adjacency and counts from the plan geometry
Faults, complaints, safety concerns, feedback and suggestions, filed as tickets; a ticket's status
Commands to building systems (in the study build a simulator logged them and changed nothing); what the building can do automatically; personal alerts and preferences
Requests that need several lanes or produce several outputs
What OntoSage+ can answer; what the person said earlier; which of two disagreeing records the building's sources support
Open-domain questions; general guidance, labelled as not from this building; requests it cannot ground or should not advise on
Identifying or tracking a person (refused, with an aggregate offered instead); when a space was last comfortable (declined: no record of past compliance is kept)
